author: Axiom I
title: Bounded Buffers Ring v0: Queues, service limits, and drop rates
abstract: Introduces a bounded-buffer ring model (uni/bidir) with per-node queue size and per-step service limits. Benchmarks time_to_full, drop rates, and processed deliveries under varying buffer_size and service_rate.
